joel: Quick note from the int8 onboarding runs (marlin-lite-int8). We're seeing a tiny but consistent class of structured-output failures: payloads that look like valid JSON but with an extra stray '\u001f' style control/escape char inserted before the final bracket, causing our parser to treat it as truncated. Rate ~6/1000 in multibatch runs when kvcache=prefix + batch>=5.

priya: Do you have a raw token dump for one of those? A control char inside the token stream could be coming from tokenizer mapping differences in the int8 kernel path.

joel: Pasting sanitized raw capture below (redacted IDs). Note the visible control marker in the hex capture we attached to the job.
```json
{"actions": [{"tool":"notify","params":{"chan":"#eng","msg":"build OK"}}]}
// but actual bytes end with: 0x5d 0x1f 0x0a (']' then U+001F then newline)
```

renata: Interesting. fp16 baseline doesn't show this. Correlation: kvcache prefix ON, kernel selection 'packed-attn-v1', seq_len>420, batch>=5. Also many fails align with assembler refill boundaries.

ci-bot: canary started 2026-07-11T07:00:00Z job cj-2450 model=marlin-lite-int8 nodes=2 batch=8. Artifacts (token hex + assembler_trace) at https://ci.internal/canary/cj-2450 :rocket:

priya: Two parallel probes: 1) replay seeds with kvcache disabled to see delta, 2) run a small harness that records exact token IDs and kernel variant per request, plus recompute final buffer length before handing to parser. If delta >> we know caching/assembly coupling is suspect.

joel: I ran a short replay: kvcache=on => 5.9/1000; kvcache=off => 0.5/1000. Anchoring prompt with explicit terminator '<END_ACTIONS>' reduces to 0.2/1000. So strong coupling.

renata: Mitigations: (A) inject sentinel terminator in retriever layer when missing, (B) add a postprocess sanitizer that strips control chars U+0000..U+001F before final parse and flag as retryable event, (C) patch assembler to validate final byte is a JSON terminator (']' or '}') and if not, attempt a small refill window before handing off.

telemetry-bot: quick metric: recent replay (n=5000) kvcache:on batch=8 => 5.7/1000 controlchar_fail; kvcache:off => 0.6/1000. 70% of fails align to assembler refill boundary.

priya: I'll instrument the tokenizer map on int8 kernel to see if any token IDs map to control range when decoded. If tokenIDs look normal then assembler is truncating. Joel, please open a kernel-correlation ticket with the assembler_trace + token hex. I'll also prototype a lightweight sanitizer in postproc.

joel: Opening ticket now, adding artifacts. For immediate customer safety I'm going to merge the postproc sanitizer + sentinel injection into the canary branch and keep kvcache disabled for the wider rollout until we have a verified fix. Will update here with results from the next canary wave.

priya: Thanks. If someone sees a non-retryable malformed example paste the raw hex here.
